pr_title: sd-event: fix memleak when built without assertion
pr_body:
Fixes a bug introduced by baf3fdec27f0b3a1f3d39c7def2a778824cbee51.

Fixes #34899.

issue_context.title: sd_event_set_signal_exit leaks memory when compiled without assertions

review_comments: `sd_event_source_set_floating` here may return `-ECHILD` and trigger the assertion. Perhaps add a top-level `assert_return` to `sd_event_set_signal_exit`?
